app.lema: Health monitoring for astronauts on missions

datalake.uso:
Usage:
  python index.py ingest goes|donki|radlab|eda [key=value ...]
  python index.py read <source> [from] [to]
  python index.py manifest
Language: VIGIA_LANG=es|en (default es)

error.gold_no_existe: gold «{nombre}» does not exist; run the pipelines/reanclaje ETL
error.gold_alterado: gold «{nombre}» does not match its SHA-256 in the manifest
error.actor_desconocido: provide a valid crew member in the X-Tripulante header
error.sin_permiso: you cannot view or modify another crew member's data
error.linea_base_no_existe: there is no baseline for that indicator and origin
error.reloj_sin_conexion: the watch server is not connected (check SMART_URL and that smart-monitor is running)
error.reloj_sin_tripulante: the watch server does not know this crew member (check SMART_TRIPULANTES or the name on the watch)
